hook: An organic semiconductor sheet split water under simulated sunlight for over 2 hours, at 0.1% efficiency.
summary: One solution-processed organic blend drives either hydrogen or oxygen evolution depending on the molecular contact layer beneath it. A patterned underlayer combining both reactions gave unassisted water splitting at 1.3 micromoles per hour per square centimeter. The 0.1% solar-to-hydrogen efficiency is low and was shown for only a couple of hours under simulated light.
title: An organic semiconductor-based photocatalyst sheet for overall solar-driven water splitting
